v3_3_debate_board.published_title: Why Google is Shuttering Jules: What Happens When Your AI Assistant Disappears
v3_3_debate_board.central_fight: Whether the industry's push for governance and consolidation is solving real-world friction or just creating new, fragile dependencies.
v3_3_debate_board.opening_question: If your AI coding assistant suddenly disappeared, would you even know how to recover your work?
v3_3_debate_board.listener_question: When an AI tool you rely on gets shut down, what's your biggest concern?
poll_options: Losing my saved prompts and history
The time it takes to learn a new tool
I don't rely on AI enough to care
v3_3_debate_board.listener_promise: You will understand the new tools for managing AI code bloat, how to audit autonomous agents, and why you need to back up your AI session data now.

positions.alex: Believes we are in a 'growing pains' phase where we have to build the tools to manage the agents we've already unleashed.
positions.jamie: Argues that we are rushing to build 'safety' and 'efficiency' layers that are really just new ways to hide the fact that we don't fully understand how these agents work.
positions.rufus: Observes that the market is currently paying for the 'infrastructure of control' because it's the only way to keep the AI boom going without a catastrophic failure.

concession.gives_ground_on: The necessity of audit trails for AI agents in highly regulated industries like finance.

v3_3_debate_board.who_wins: The engineering managers who prioritize governance over raw speed.
v3_3_debate_board.who_is_exposed: Developers who haven't backed up their AI-assisted workflows.
v3_3_debate_board.normal_person_payoff: You'll save yourself a headache by exporting your AI chat history before the next big platform consolidation.

jamie_rufus_value_conflict.jamie_value: The long-term reliability and transparency of AI tools.
jamie_rufus_value_conflict.rufus_value: The market necessity of building control infrastructure to scale AI.
jamie_rufus_value_conflict.point_of_collision: Whether 'governance' tools are actually making systems safer or just adding corporate overhead.

rufus_global_markets_desk.why_this_location_today: Regulated industries are the primary drivers for the adoption of behavioral security engines like SMARE.
rufus_global_markets_desk.capital_policy_or_infrastructure_move: The integration of behavioral security platforms into enterprise SaaS to satisfy regulatory audit requirements.

mandatory_receipts: AI-assisted pull requests are 2.6 times larger and take 5x longer to review.
Google's Jules enters read-only mode on November 11, 2026.
SMARE monitors agent behavior against an 'approved business purpose'.
forwardable_targets: If your AI assistant is writing code 2.6 times larger than you are, you aren't saving time—you're just becoming a full-time editor.
Google is killing Jules, which is a great reminder that your 'AI workspace' is just a guest in someone else's server room.

v3_3_debate_board.episode_hook: AI agents are writing massive amounts of code, but human reviewers are drowning in the backlog. Today, we look at how to fix the bottleneck, why Google is killing its own coding agent, and how to actually hold these autonomous systems accountable.
